recipes.name: Lemon spaghetti
recipes.method: Boil the pasta. Warm sliced garlic in the oil, add zest and juice plus a splash of pasta water, toss with the pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, stir in the spices, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until just set.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
recipes.method: Stir everything but the banana together, leave in the fridge overnight, top with sliced banana in the morning.

recipes.name: Cheese quesadillas + black bean soup
recipes.method: Soften the onion and garlic in oil, add the spices, beans and stock, simmer 15 minutes and crush about half the beans for body. For the quesadillas, fill tortillas with cheddar, dry-fry 2–3 minutes a side until crisp and golden, cut into wedges. Serve with lime and soured cream.

recipes.name: Grilled cheese + tomato soup
recipes.method: Sweat onion, carrot and garlic in a little butter, stir in the purée, then the tomatoes, stock and sugar. Simmer 20 minutes and blitz smooth. Butter the bread on the outside, sandwich the cheddar, and griddle low and slow until deep gold on both sides — low heat keeps the crust from burning before the cheese melts. Cut in half and dunk.

recipes.name: Asian soup dumplings and broth
ingredients: 2 spring onions, plus extra to serve
recipes.method: Simmer the stock with ginger, star anise and the spring onion whites for 10 minutes, then strain and season with soy and sesame oil. Steam the dumplings 8–10 minutes from frozen. Blanch the pak choi in the broth for a minute, then ladle the broth over the dumplings and greens and finish with chilli oil and sliced spring onion.

recipes.name: Feta and cherry tomato bake over noodles or chickpeas
recipes.method: Put the feta in a baking dish with the tomatoes and garlic, pour over the oil, scatter oregano and chilli, and bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until the tomatoes burst. Squeeze the garlic out of its skins, mash everything into a rough sauce with the lemon juice, and fold through cooked noodles or warmed chickpeas. Basil on top.

recipes.name: Bolognese over noodles
recipes.method: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in oil for 10 minutes until soft, add the garlic, then brown the mince properly. Add the wine and let it reduce, then the milk, purée and tomatoes. Simmer gently for 45–60 minutes — longer is better — and season. Toss with cooked noodles and plenty of parmesan.

recipes.name: Udon stir fry
recipes.method: Sear the tofu or chicken in a hot pan until browned, then add garlic, ginger, mushrooms and pak choi and stir-fry 2–3 minutes. Add the udon (loosened in hot water first) and the soy, mirin and sesame oil, and toss over high heat until glossy. Finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Chicken fiesta soup
ingredients: coriander, avocado and tortilla chips to serve
recipes.method: Soften the onion and jalapeño, add the spices, tomatoes and stock, then the whole chicken breasts. Simmer 20 minutes, lift the chicken out and shred it, and return it with the beans and corn. Season with lime, and serve with avocado, coriander and crushed tortilla chips.

recipes.name: White bean lemon smash
recipes.method: Warm the sliced garlic in the oil, add the beans, thyme and stock, and simmer 5 minutes. Crush roughly with a fork, keeping some texture, then finish with the lemon zest and juice and plenty of black pepper. Spoon onto toast with more oil on top.

recipes.name: Sundried tomato white beans ("marry me")
ingredients: 1 tbsp oil from the tomato jar
recipes.method: Soften the garlic and sundried tomatoes in the tomato oil, add the paprika, beans and stock, and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in the cream and parmesan until the sauce thickens around the beans, then finish with basil. Good with bread and nothing else.

recipes.name: Tortellini soup
recipes.method: Soften the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes, stock and oregano, and simmer 10 minutes. Add the courgette and tortellini and cook 4 minutes until the pasta floats, then wilt in the spinach. Serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian wedding soup (macaroni, sausage, kale, tomato)
recipes.method: Mix the sausage meat with the egg, parmesan and breadcrumbs and roll into small balls; brown them in the pot and set aside. Soften the onion, carrot and garlic, add the tomatoes and stock, return the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes. Add the macaroni and kale and cook 8 minutes more until the pasta is tender.

recipes.name: Feta, chicken and artichoke (Mediterranean chicken salad)
recipes.method: Rub the chicken with oregano, salt and oil and griddle 5–6 minutes a side, then rest and slice. Toss with the artichokes, tomatoes, onion, cucumber and olives, dress with lemon, oil and garlic, and crumble the feta over the top.

recipes.name: Halloumi
recipes.method: Slice the halloumi about 1cm thick, pat dry, and griddle in a dry pan 2 minutes a side until deeply marked. Dress immediately with lemon juice, honey, oil, chilli and torn mint, and serve with warm flatbread and sliced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Chili
ingredients: 500g beef mince (or 2 extra tins of beans)
rice, soured cream and coriander to serve
recipes.method: Brown the mince hard, then add the onion and pepper and cook until soft. Stir in the garlic, spices and purée, then the tomatoes and stock, and simmer 45 minutes. Add both tins of beans and cook 15 minutes more, then stir in the chocolate and check the seasoning. Serve over rice with soured cream and coriander.

recipes.name: Pork and green bean stir-fry over rice
ingredients: 300g ground pork (squeezed out of sausage links, casings off)
250g green beans, trimmed and cut into short lengths
3 spring onions or a small bunch of chives, sliced
recipes.method: Get the pan properly hot with the oil and blister the green beans for 3–4 minutes until they wrinkle and colour, then push them to the edge. Add the pork, break it up, and fry hard until browned with no pink left — sausage meat is already seasoned, so it needs no salt. Add the garlic, let it catch for 30 seconds, then splash in the soy sauce and toss everything together for another minute. Serve over hot rice, scattered with sliced spring onion or chives. A teaspoon of chilli oil or a pinch of sugar in the soy is worth it if you have them to hand.
